newsitem.title: USA: Gruntal & Co hires new telecomm equip/svc analyst.
newsitem.headline: Gruntal & Co hires new telecomm equip/svc analyst.

text.p: Gruntal & Co Inc said on Monday that Thomas Calcagnini has joined its equity research department as a vice president and telecommunications equipment and services analyst.
Calcagnini, a certified public accountant, previously analyzed telecommunications companies at Cruttendon Roth. He would now be based in Gruntal's Beverly Hill, Calif. office, the company said.
He also covered telecommunications services and the wireless industries for First Manhattan Co and spent five years at Bear Sterns as an associate analyst in telecommunications.
